teaser: The coffee machine in the break room sputters and burns before anyone notices, and that particular over-held note — too long under heat — is close to what an 11 crossed with an INTP carries without saying. You are a life path eleven, the number that asks for a kind of charged presence most people only manage on their best days, and an INTP, built to turn everything over in private before showing a single conclusion. The two meet in a strange static: a mind built to withhold answers until certain, sitting under a path that keeps handing you intensity before certainty ever arrives.
excerpt: Has anyone ever said you went quiet at the exact moment they needed you loud?
